appearances.title: FineDNA and Carbon-X open a DNA language-model training stack
appearances.summary: FineDNA is a public dataset for teaching language models DNA: 300B+ tokens of genomic sequence, papers, and mixed DNA-text, plus 200k SFT and 98k RL samples. Training Qwen3-14B on it produces Carbon-X, which the authors report beats other open language models on DNA tasks.
